metadata.description: Local, fully private temporal memory for Claude Code, built by Jim Cline.

plugins.name: engram
plugins.description: Local-only temporal memory for Claude Code sessions. Adds an MCP server plus SessionStart, PreCompact, and file-touched hooks backed by a single-binary, append-only SQLite store at ~/.engram — no account, no network calls, no daemon. Facts are never mutated or deleted, only superseded, with the reason for every revision recorded.
